question_asked: Are both the Houston Ship Channel and Carondelet Canal still in operation?

entities_involved.name: Houston Ship Channel
entities_involved.operational_status_details: The Houston Ship Channel... is part of the Port of Houston, one of the US's busiest seaports. The channel is the conduit for ocean-going vessels between Houston-area terminals and the Gulf of Mexico, and it serves an increasing volume of inland barge traffic.

entities_involved.name: Carondelet Canal
entities_involved.operational_status_details: The Carondelet Canal... ceased to be navigable in 1927 and was filled in 1938.
